rules.name: Sappers
rules.description: All models in a unit with this Veteran Skill gain the Melta Bomb wargear. The unit gains the Infiltrate and Siege Attacker special rules.

rules.name: Marksmen
rules.description: A unit with this Veteran Skill gains the Precision Hits & Rending (6+) special rule on all Las Guns they are equipped with.

rules.name: Grenadiers
rules.description: All models in a unit with this Veteran Skill gains the Krak Grenade wargear and exchanges their Flak Armour for Carapace Armour.

rules.name: Survivalists
rules.description: All models in a unit with this Veteran Skill gain the Move Through Cover, Skirmisher and Feel no Pain (6+) special rules.

sharedRules.name: Section
sharedRules.description: An Imperial Guard unit with this special rule is made up of multiple individual units. Units purchased as part of a section count as a single choice in the Force Organization chart, taking a combined single slot and as a single unit for deployment but act as individual units for all other purposes as normal after deployed. When purchasing units as part of a section, all wargear and upgrades are purchased individually on a unit-by-unit basis.

sharedRules.name: Officer (x)
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule generates a number Command Points equal to the value of (x) at the start of each Battle Round, if the unit has not been slain. The unit does not need to be on the Battlefield and may be within a Transport unit.

sharedRules.name: Combat Orders
sharedRules.description:
At the beginning of each Battle Round, an Imperial Guard army generates 1 Command Point (CP) plus a number of Command Points (CP) equal to the total value of (x) from all units in your army with the officer (x) special rule. This includes units which are not on the battlefield, either in reserves or in Transports.


These command points may be spent at various times during either player turn. At the end the battle round, any unspent Command Points are lost.


To issue an order, you must select 1 unit with the Character special rule in our army to issue an order. You must then select 1 unit wholly within 18" of the Character capable of receiving that Order. Each time a character successfully issues an order, subtract 1 from your available pool of CP. A unit can only receive 1 Order per phase. Models with 'Sergeant' in their name may also issue orders but may only issue orders to the unit that they are part of. Each order specifies when and how it is to be used.

sharedRules.name: Blitzkrieg
sharedRules.description: Vehicle, Bike and Cavalry units in your army gain the Scout special rule. Infantry units gain the Sprint (1) special rule. Infantry units within 6” of a friendly Vehicle type unit gain the Sprint (2) special rule instead.

sharedRules.name: Buzzsaw
sharedRules.description: Units in your army make 1 extra attack with Heavy Stubbers, Linked Heavy Stubbers, Punisher Gatling Cannons, Heavy Bolters and Linked Heavy Bolters they are equipped with.

sharedRules.name: Jury Rig
sharedRules.description: Vehicle units in army gain the Battle Smith (1) special rule however, these units may only perform the Rite of Repair on themselves.

sharedRules.name: Wave Tactics
sharedRules.description: At the start of the Movement Phase, you can spend 1 Command Point to rally Conscripts around a squad. Select 1 Conscript Squad within 18” of a unit with the Officer special rule or as if issuing a Combat Order. The target unit regains D3 slain Conscript models. A Conscript Squad unit may not be targeted by this effect more than once per turn.

sharedRules.name: Disciplined Reserves
sharedRules.description: Cadian Shock Trooper Conscript Squads gain +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS), Weapon Skill (WS), and Leadership (LD) characteristics. In addition, they gain the Preferred Enemy (Chaos) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Armoured Raiders
sharedRules.description: Armageddon Steel Legion Infantry units gain the Linked special rule during the turn they Disembark from a Transport. This does not apply to Emergency  Disembarkation as a result of the Transport being destroyed.

sharedRules.name: Suicidal Determination
sharedRules.description: Death Korp of Krieg Infantry & Cavalry units gain the Zealot special rules.

sharedRules.name: Screened Drop
sharedRules.description: During the first battle round, all Elysian Drop Troops Infantry units gain a 4+ Cover Save. In addition, half of your units in reserve that have the Elysian Drop Troops Keyword may arrive during the first battle round.

sharedRules.name: Armoured Fighters
sharedRules.description: Tallarn Desert Fighter Vehicle and Walker units gain the Hit & Run.

sharedRules.name: Parade Discipline
sharedRules.description: Mordian Iron Guard Infantry units that have all models in the unit in base contact with each other, gain the Stubborn special rule.

sharedRules.name: Against the Odds
sharedRules.description: Valhallan Ice Warrior units do not suffer Movement Penalties in their next Movement Phase from Going to Ground or being Pinned. In addition, they gain the Preferred Enemy (Orks) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Classist Soldiery
sharedRules.description: During the first battle round, units with the Officer (x) special rule do not generate any Command Points.

sharedRules.name: Heirloom Weapons
sharedRules.description: All Vostroyan First Born units increase the Strength of their Las Guns and Las Pistols by 1.

sharedRules.name: Chemical Mental Boosters
sharedRules.description: Savlar Chem Dogs units only make Panic tests in the Shooting Phase after suffering 50% casualties.

sharedRules.name: Penal Battalions
sharedRules.description: All units in your army gain the Expendable Keyword. Your army must include at least 2 units of Penal Squads.

sharedRules.name: Light Horsemen
sharedRules.description: All Attilan Rough Rider Cavalry units gain the Sudden Strike special rules.

sharedRules.name: Light Infantry Tactics
sharedRules.description: All Tanith First & Only Infantry and Walker units gain the Skirmisher special rule.

sharedRules.name: Bullgryn Plate
sharedRules.description: Heavy Plate worn by Bullgryn Assault Troops. This confers a 3+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Slab Shield
sharedRules.description: A model with this Wargear has a 2+ Armour save if they remained stationary in the movement phase. In addition, any charges against a unit which contains 2 or more models with this wargear is considered a Disordered Charge.

sharedRules.name: Brute Shield
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable save. A model equipped with this wargear gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

sharedRules.name: Supreme Commander
sharedRules.description: If this unit is slain, your opponent gains 1 Victory Point. This unit can be included in any Imperial Guard army regardless of Allegiance.

sharedRules.name: Morale Officer
sharedRules.description: This unit and any attached unit have the Stubborn special rule. This unit and any attached unit count as scoring 1 additional wound in the Combat Phase when determining who won combat.

sharedRules.name: Execution
sharedRules.description: When any attached unit would fail a Pinning or Panic test, you can opt to slay 1 friendly model from the attached unit. That is considered to have passed the Pinning and Panic test.

sharedRules.name: Refractor field
sharedRules.description: A model with a refractor Field has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Field Piece
sharedRules.description: This unit may only embark on the Centaur Light Carrier and may only do so if the unit size is 1 model.

sharedRules.name: Scholar Drilled
sharedRules.description: A Tempestor model counts as Sergeant for the purposes of issuing Combat Orders. A unit with this special rule may issue Orders (see Combat Orders) to itself even if it does not have a Tempestor model.

sharedRules.name: Overburdened Engine
sharedRules.description: When this unit suffers a Crew Injured Result, instead of halving this models Movement (M) characteristic, it is instead reduced to 2”.

sharedRules.name: Stalling Machine Spirit
sharedRules.description: Each time this unit attempts to perform a Retreat Move in the Movement Phase, it must perform a Leadership test. If the test is failed, the unit may not perform the move and must remain stationary that Movement Phase. If the test is passed, the unit may perform the Retreat Move as normal.

sharedRules.name: Icarus Defences
sharedRules.description: Any Linked Autocannon or Linked Las Cannon that the Bastion is equipped with gains the Skyfire special rule.

rules.name: Camo Cloaks
rules.description: A Model with a Camo Cloak gains the benefit of Light Cover even if they would not normally do so. In addition, if they are already benefiting from Light Cover, they receive Heavy Cover instead. A model with this wargear gains a 4+ Cover save if it is already receiving the benefit of Heavy Cover.

rules.name: Command Rod
rules.description: A model with this wargear and any attached unit re-roll Panic tests.

rules.name: Platoon Standard
rules.description: Friendly imperial Guard units within 18” of a model equipped with this wargear may re-roll Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, friendly Imperial Guard units within 18” count as having scored 1 additional wound in combat for the purposes of determining who won combat.

rules.name: Armoured Plate
rules.description: Heavy Armoured plating protects the armoured walking vehicles of the Guard. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: The Deathmask of Ollanius
rules.description: A model equipped with this relic wargear gains a 4+ Invulnerable save and the Feel no Pain (5+) and Battle-Hardened special rules.

rules.name: Draconian Disciplinarian:
rules.description: Any unit that draws visibility to this unit or any unit it is attached to (including the Transport this unit is embarked in), may use this Warlord’s Leadership (LD) characteristic for Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Master of Command
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Officer (1) special rule. If the Warlord already has the Officer (x) special rule, they increase the value of (x) by 1.

rules.name: Grand Strategist

rules.name: Psyker Attache

rules.name: Re-Breather Mask
rules.description: A model with this wargear may re-roll save rolls (Armour only) against wounds caused by weapons with the Poison (x) special rule.

rules.name: Shield Plate
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 4+ Armour save. A model with this wargear may re-roll all save rolls (Armour saves only) against weapons with the Blast, Large Blast and Spray special rules.

rules.name: Air Defence Relay
rules.description: If a unit has a model equipped with this wargear, the entire unit gains the Skyfire special rule on all shooting weapons they are equipped with. In addition, this unit may always target enemy units with the Fly special rule even if it is not the closest visible unit in range.

rules.name: Telekinetic Dome (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any unit they are attached to gain a 5+ Invulnerable save until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If the Psyker remained stationary in the previous Movement Phase, this becomes a 4+ Invulnerable save instead.

rules.name: Nightshroud (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any unit they are attached to gain the benefit of Heavy Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Mind Shackle (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. That target unit is immediately Pinned until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Psychic Maelstrom (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, place a single storm marker within 12” of the Psyker. Each time this Psychic Power is cast, remove any existing storm markers from the battlefield and place a new one within 12” of the Caster. When casting this Psychic Power, a Psyker can instead move the existing storm marker on a successful Psychic test instead of placing a new marker. The storm marker is moved 2D6” on a successful Psychic test. Units within 6” of the storm marker at the end of the Shooting Phase and each Movement Phase take 3D6,  trength 3, AP-, Automatic Hits.

rules.name: Rite of Repair (Machine Rite)
rules.description:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:
• Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3” or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
• Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
• Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

rules.name: Rite of Immolation (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6” of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately suffers an Explodes result per the Vehicle Damage Chart, even if it would normally not.

rules.name: Litany of Foxus (Prayer)
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Litany of Hatred (Prayer)
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
